name: counted
description: Privacy-focused app analytics with composable dashboards

scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun run openapi:generate
scripts.test: bun test packages/kernel packages/authorization packages/identity packages/persistence packages/tenancy packages/projects packages/ingestion packages/analytics packages/dashboarding packages/contract packages/openapi packages/adapters packages/sdk-js packages/agent-core packages/agent-cli packages/aptabase-compat packages/migrate apps && bun run --cwd packages/react test
scripts.contract:check: bun scripts/generate-contract.ts && git diff --exit-code -- packages/sdk-js/src/gen packages/python/counted/_contract.py packages/go/contract_gen.go packages/rust/src/contract.rs packages/agent-core/src/gen packages/ingestion/domain/src/gen
scripts.conformance:build: cd packages/rust && cargo build --bin conformance && cd ../go && go build -o bin/conformance ./cmd/conformance
scripts.agents:build: bun run --cwd packages/agent-cli build && bun run --cwd packages/agent-claude-code build && bun run --cwd packages/agent-opencode build
scripts.sdks:build: bun run --cwd packages/sdk-js build && bun run --cwd packages/agent-core build && bun run --cwd packages/react build && bun run --cwd packages/migrate build && bun run agents:build
